steps.title: Filing of Civil Claim
steps.description: A civil claim is filed before the competent court through the Najiz electronic portal or court registry, in accordance with the Law of Civil Procedure.

steps.title: Case Registration and Notification
steps.description: Court registers the case and notifies the defendant of the claim and hearing details.

steps.title: Submission of Defence
steps.description: Defendant submits a written defence or response within the prescribed timeframe.

steps.title: Hearings and Evidence
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, reviews documentary evidence, and hears submissions from the parties.

steps.title: Expert Review (If Applicable)
steps.description: Court may appoint an expert to review technical or financial matters, where required.

steps.title: Final Hearing
steps.description: Court closes pleadings and hears final submissions from the parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment resolving the civil dispute.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Judgment may be enforced through execution procedures if not complied with voluntarily.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under the Law of Civil Procedure
Appeal on points of law or procedural review as permitted under Saudi law
